recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-24625; any separate rendering issue around experimental flags belongs to the later terminology/tooling issue family.
issue_request: FHIR-24625 was a Published/Persuasive CQI change request for R5 asking Measure metadata definitions to separate the term from the definition, using a CodeableConcept for the term and markdown for the definition.
initial_application: The issue was applied by #24625 commits before this reconciliation: 2df05d1471 replaced Measure.definition with the Measure.term backbone and code/definition children, 8f9dac369a migrated the exclusive-breastfeeding example, 0772d5ef85 added the measure-definition-example binding and terminology, and fb1432b692 merged PR 2301.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps measure=Measure active. Current source/measure/structuredefinition-Measure.xml defines Measure.term, Measure.term.code, and Measure.term.definition; the R5 published profile has the same surface and no Measure.definition element. Later FHIR-50265 confirms Measure.term as the R5 expression of the prior definition-term concept, while FHIR-55080 references the same Measure.term.code binding and only addresses example value set experimental treatment.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the current source already satisfies the structural request and a source edit would risk conflicting with the R5/R6 published shape.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-qm issue explicitly treats Measure.term as the R5 representation of the old definition-term concept.
Later core Measure terminology issue references Measure.term.code and the measure-definition-example binding without changing the FHIR-24625 structure.
